instruction: Please help me by opening the link found in the most recent email in the Bills folder in a new Chrome tab.

metadata.explanation: Variation 0: Paraphrased instruction. Task requires opening the first link (https://www.amazon.com/) from the latest email in the Bills folder in a new Chrome tab. The evaluator checks that all three tabs are open: the two initial tabs (apple.com, scholar.google.com) plus the newly opened amazon.com tab. Uses existing is_expected_tabs function with open_tabs_info getter.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the end result: checks if amazon.com tab is opened in Chrome alongside the initial tabs
Getter (get_open_tabs_info) can properly extract Chrome tab state via CDP connection with retry logic
Metric (is_expected_tabs) correctly compares expected vs actual URLs using proper URL comparison
Expected values are semantically correct: 2 initial tabs + 1 newly opened amazon.com tab
State is accessible at runtime - Chrome tabs persist after actions, no postconfig needed
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider that the evaluator only verifies the end state (tab opened) but doesn't verify intermediate steps (opening Thunderbird, finding email, extracting link). While this is acceptable for result-based verification, it means an agent could pass by directly opening amazon.com without following the correct process. This is a common trade-off in verification design and not a critical flaw for this task type.
